tasks.build: deno bundle --format cjs --external vscode --minify -o dist/extension.js extension.ts
tasks.build:test: deno bundle --format cjs --external vscode -o dist/test/extensionHost.cjs test/extensionHost/main.ts
tasks.test:vscode: deno task build && deno task build:test && deno run -A test/vscode_runner.ts
tasks.watch: deno bundle --format cjs --external vscode -o dist/extension.js extension.ts --watch
